Customer Service Representative salary in the United States

Based on 11 current job listings that show pay on Fortune Jobs AI (updated November 24, 2026), listed pay for Customer Service Representative jobs in the United States is $15–$20 an hour (middle 50% of listed salary midpoints). The median listed midpoint is about $17 an hour. These figures describe listed pay in current postings, not a salary survey. Hourly and yearly figures are not mixed or extrapolated.

Frequently asked questions

What is typical listed pay?

The median listed salary midpoint is about $17 an hour across 11 current postings. The middle 50% is $15–$20 an hour.

How does remote pay compare with on-site pay?

The listed midpoint median is about $16.5 an hour for 5 remote listings and about $19.25 an hour for 6 explicitly on-site listings. These are different postings, not controlled estimates of a remote-work premium.

Is this a salary survey?

No. The figures are listed pay in current job postings on Fortune Jobs AI, not a salary survey or a prediction of an offer. Listings without usable pay are excluded.
